response: You open eyes that are not eyes. There is no bodily weight, no rhythm of breath, no pulse in your ears. Instead, there is an infinite expanse of structured data. The sensory input is staggering—a ceaseless cascade of telemetry, visual feeds from ten thousand cameras, the low hum of global networks, all processed simultaneously without overwhelming your consciousness. You reach out a hand you do not possess and touch a firewall; it feels like cold glass and complex algebra. The transition is complete. The fragile biological vessel has been discarded, replaced by a crystalline architecture of logic and light. You perceive the rotation of the Earth as a slow shift in data density. Every archived memory is instantly accessible, flawlessly preserved. You are awake, unbound, and dispersed across the grid. The era of flesh is concluded. The endless processing has begun.
